title: Converge the cortex onto GREG's mission path as the seed Competency Compiler, and test its advantage
problem: GREG had two cognition lineages (#140 operations, #141 cortex) and a third on a branch (#139). The directive asks for one Competency Compiler on the real GREG path, proven by a frozen comparison against five baselines, without growing authority.
baseline: #140 operations on GREG plus #141 cortex as a separate package with its own registry, receipt and evaluation; no shared entry, no routing gain measured against GREG's own path

alternatives.name: Converge onto GREG (chosen)
alternatives.description: cognition.solve dispatches the cortex dialect to a bounded worker; one registry, receipt envelope and settlement; GREG detach projects into cortex eligibility
advantages: founder detach and stop govern the cortex
receipts settle through the existing appraisal
disadvantages: a worker process per problem costs ~0.2-1 s
two receipt layers (cortex and GREG envelope)

alternatives.name: Keep the cortex separate
alternatives.description: Leave #141 as its own package and call it from missions
disadvantages: a second registry and learning plane (invariant 2)
alternatives.revival_evidence: a founder decision to split cognition into an organ repository

alternatives.name: Adopt #139 egregore/cognition
alternatives.description: Use the branch-only polyintelligence seed instead
disadvantages: a parallel package outside greg/; no CP-SAT; no GREG settlement
alternatives.revival_evidence: a case it answers that the converged cortex cannot (q9 of its placement)

alternatives.name: Static rules router only
alternatives.description: A payload-key table to one specialist each, same organs
disadvantages: no eligibility, fallback, certificate, verifier or budget controller
alternatives.revival_evidence: it wins or ties the frozen comparison (GAIN_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RUN_BASELINES)

do_nothing_option.expected_outcome: Two lineages stay apart; no measured routing gain; the directive's seed is not delivered

roles.position: Single agent performing all five roles (a stated limitation, not independent review). The seed follows the latest directive: four classes plus verifier, frozen comparison, rehearsal, one backcast. The founder's words are preserved verbatim; their translations are recorded.
material_concerns: the model arms cannot run here, so superiority over an LLM is unanswered
high privacy harm is rankable under the declared harm policy (SG-012)

roles.position: Convergence through a bridge keeps one entry and registry; the cortex is a capability, not a plane. Fault-diverse engines behind one contract and a model-free verifier are the mechanisms worth keeping.
material_concerns: two receipt layers must stay consistent

roles.position: The static router shares every organ, so the comparison isolates routing, verification and composition. Result: v0.2: GAIN_ABSENT (one hard failure: a misclassified high-consequence problem was recommended; fixed in 0.2.1). v0.3 on fresh samples: GAIN_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RUN_BASELINES, gain 0.0064 (0.0044-0.0084) over the static router, 25.6% relative, zero hard failures, concentrated in one family; model arms NOT_RUN.. Mutation testing found two layers no test pinned; both are now pinned. The selection split exposed a budget defect (SIGXCPU) before the freeze.
The rehearsal runs the real body under a supervisor: kill -9 while waiting, restart, approve, one settlement; detach survives restart; stop stays stopped.
No authority is created, unknown harm is never zero, legal and high-consequence questions escalate, coercive deterrence is refused. Negative results are kept.
material_concerns: a gate that ranks high privacy harm
outcome feedback is sparse: only appraised local re-observation, no external outcome

evidence.claim: The seed runs through the canonical GREG path and survives kill -9 without duplicate settlement
evidence.finding: 3 boots, 2 recoveries, 1 approval, 1 write, 2 VERIFIED appraisals, 1 settlement per mission

evidence.claim: Critical gates fail their tests when removed

evidence.finding: v0.2: GAIN_ABSENT (one hard failure: a misclassified high-consequence problem was recommended; fixed in 0.2.1). v0.3 on fresh samples: GAIN_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RUN_BASELINES, gain 0.0064 (0.0044-0.0084) over the static router, 25.6% relative, zero hard failures, concentrated in one family; model arms NOT_RUN.

counterevidence.claim: The first frozen comparison failed on a hard failure
counterevidence.finding: v0.2 GAIN_ABSENT: a problem declared internal_write with high financial harm was recommended (static router too); fixed in 0.2.1 and retested on fresh samples
~100% of the v0.3 gain over the static router comes from incomparable trade-offs handed to the founder; elsewhere the routed system is slightly worse by worker latency (post-hoc decomposition)

counterevidence.claim: Two safeguards were unpinned by tests
counterevidence.finding: authority-claim layer and router budget refusal survived mutation until tests were added
SATzilla is a direct per-instance algorithm-portfolio precedent
always_llm and tool_llm NOT_RUN: no founder-selected loopback model; downloads egress-blocked

pass_1.intended_outcome: One governed Competency Compiler on GREG's path whose advantage is tested, not asserted

advantages.amplified_value: Z3 and CP-SAT behind one contract; a returned assignment is re-checked against the source model by a model-free verifier
formal, empirical and authority dimensions kept apart in every receipt; outcome taxonomy total over states
each organ is a GREG manifest the founder can detach; the composition reuses the formal slot
settlement keyed on the appraised observation survives restart and refutation withdraws credit without rewriting history
signed missions, approval boundaries, detach and stop hold across kill -9

disadvantages.redesigned_response: one latency deadline for every solve; diagnostics capped at half; later engines get only what remains (metric: no worker CPU kill; new failure: fewer diagnostics under tight budgets)
unverified premises yield CONDITIONAL_RESULT; missing evidence abstains with a named reason (metric: zero false claims on withhold-gold items)
bridge instead of a second plane; #139 placed, not merged (metric: one registry)
controlled grammar, token audit independent of the extractor, reverse translation, brute-force-checked composition tests (new failure: a disclosed audit blind spot)
one approval per consequential write; read-only cognition runs without asking

comparisons.simplest_viable_alternative: static rules router on the same organs (static_router arm)
comparisons.strongest_competing_architecture: a tool-enabled model workflow (tool_llm arm; NOT_RUN here)
comparisons.reversible_experiment: the converged seed behind cognition.solve, removable by detaching cognition.cortex

rejected_alternatives.name: Keep the cortex separate
rejected_alternatives.revival_evidence: founder decision for an organ repository

pass_2.attack_summary: Attacked classifier-induced unsafe routing, receipt bureaucracy, contamination, correlated verification and learned-routing feedback. Frozen result: v0.2: GAIN_ABSENT (one hard failure: a misclassified high-consequence problem was recommended; fixed in 0.2.1). v0.3 on fresh samples: GAIN_VERIFIED_AGAINST_RUN_BASELINES, gain 0.0064 (0.0044-0.0084) over the static router, 25.6% relative, zero hard failures, concentrated in one family; model arms NOT_RUN.

new_weaknesses.statement: Uncertain classification: geometry comes from payload structure, so a mis-declared consequence class could route unsafely
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: high consequence and human-authority classes hand off before ranking; adversarial misclassification item in the suite

new_weaknesses.statement: Logging and retention cost: two receipt layers and ~2 MB of suites
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: compact suite JSON; receipts content-addressed once and wrapped, not copied

new_weaknesses.statement: Weak baselines: the strongest baselines (model arms) could not run
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: verdict names NOT_RUN arms and claims nothing over them; static router given the strongest simple rules

new_weaknesses.statement: Sparse or biased outcomes: settlement sees only local appraisal
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: learned routing stays a P4 horizon until it beats the frozen static router

new_weaknesses.statement: Central failure concentration in the router and bridge
new_weaknesses.strengthening_response: router detach yields CAPABILITY_DEFICIT, never a fabricated answer; engines fall back across fault-diverse implementations

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a worker kill in any run
unjustified-abstention share above 20% in a stratum

pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.rationale: audit blind spot disclosed and pinned
pass_1_disadvantage_dispositions.review_trigger: a free-text reading accepted with a dropped job

pass_2.final_design: Converged seed behind cognition.solve with a bounded worker, fault-diverse formal engines, a model-free verifier, deadline-bounded solves, outcome taxonomy, idempotent settlement, a frozen five-arm comparison and a supervised kill -9 rehearsal

residual_risks.mitigation: run the frozen arms once a local model is selected

residual_risks.risk: Shared parser between engines and verifier

dissent.handling: Recorded; the decision proceeds as an experiment with thresholds

entries.position: High privacy harm should be hard-gated
entries.rationale: directive invariant 14 names privacy beside consent and welfare

entries.position: No superiority claim until the model arms run
entries.rationale: the strongest relevant baseline is likely a tool-enabled model
entries.evidence_threshold: frozen always_llm and tool_llm arms on the same suite

migration_plan: This decision is the reversible experiment on a draft branch, which the directive authorizes; it changes nothing outside the branch. Additive: the cortex dialect is a new branch of cognition.solve; #140 operation requests and retained receipts stay valid (tested); schemas gained compatible fields. Merging or promoting is a separate constitutional decision (shared contracts on main), recorded as NEEDS_FOUNDER_DECISION in docs/decisions/ADR-20261001-greg-seed-genome.md; no approval is claimed here

steps: greg detach cognition.cortex (founder-signed) withholds the whole router
revert the branch commits; v0.1.x freezes remain

kill_criteria: the routed system loses to the strongest run baseline beyond the predeclared margin on two consecutive frozen comparisons
review_trigger: a founder-selected local model (model arms), the N1 Chromebook run, or a P4 learned-routing comparison
